verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents adding SAFEs directly to the cap table (eqvista-docs-10), built-in e-signing for equity agreements (eqvista-docs-11), and a support article on converting notes with the price-per-share method (eqvista-docs-18). That covers recording SAFEs/notes and some conversion handling. However, the evidence never shows generating and sending SAFE or note documents in-platform, never ties e-signing specifically to SAFEs or notes, and does not show that conversion terms (cap, discount, MFN) are modeled on the cap table rather than worked out in a spreadsheet. Missing for 10: in-platform SAFE/note document creation and sending, e-signing explicitly applied to SAFEs/notes, documented modeling of conversion terms (caps/discounts) within round modeling, independent corroboration.
